title: AI identity suggestions
intro: Describe the site and let a configured text AI propose colours, fonts, taglines and a written logo brief. Every suggestion lands in the Identity draft for you to review, never on the live site.
scope: No images, vectors or GIFs are generated: this module produces text only (colours, fonts, taglines and a written logo brief). A provider is called only after you preview the exact request and approve its estimated cost.
connection_help: Choose a saved AI connection or the site's writing settings. Keys stay on the server; nothing is sent until you approve.
preview_help: Preview shows the provider, model, host, the exact prompt and the estimated cost. It sends nothing.
cost_detail: about %d input and up to %d output tokens at $%.2f / $%.2f per million, from the provider's public price list on %s; your account may be billed differently.
cost_unknown: No estimate: this model is not in the price list copied on %s. Check the provider's price list before approving.
approve: I reviewed the request and the estimated cost, and I approve one paid generation.
result_help: The identity draft now holds these values. Review them with the live preview, then apply or discard on
logo_brief_help: Written guidance for a designer; the AI cannot draw and no image was produced.
error_not_ready: No AI connection is ready: choose a saved AI connection or configure the site's writing settings with a readable key.
error_approval: Tick the approval box to generate.
error_review: The reviewed request expired or was already used. Preview it again.
error_upstream: The provider did not answer successfully. Nothing was changed; preview and try again.
error_reply: The provider's answer could not be used as an identity (invalid colours, fonts or contrast). Nothing was changed.
not_saved: not saved, copy it if needed
error_theme_unsupported: The active theme does not accept identity settings (its theme.json does not declare "identity"), so colours and fonts would never be shown. Switch to a theme that supports identity first.
error_failed: The suggestion could not be stored. Nothing was changed; try again.
error_changed: The AI connection, its key or the active theme changed since the preview, so the approval no longer covers the request. Nothing was sent. Preview again to review the current destination and cost.
